title: The Orpheum circuit and the Hugh Wiley shorts for Pathe
summary: After touring the Orpheum circuit to California they auditioned for Pathe and made eight Hugh Wiley shorts, working long hours under a director they had recommended.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: So we go on the Orpheum circuit on bills with Frances White and Walker -- Walker-- can't think of his first name. And there are quite a few acts on the bill. However, However, we played the Orpheum circuit to California, we got into California and we got an audition to do for the Pathe' Studio, we got an audition for Pathe' Studio and we got a chance to make some Hugh Wiley shorts.

I'm 19 by now. Hugh Wiley shorts, Dimmie & Wildcat and I made eight of them. Then the manager wanted to show that he could direct a picture better for us than we could do under anybody else's direction. Which was a sad situation, so I gotta vouch for him that we could do better with some other director than we can with him than with any other director. We had to vouch for him to become our director. Buck and Bubbles are so strong with their talent that what we say concerning being directed would be taken up by the studio to the extent of changing the director for the picture and get him a job since we can do better. We got him the job and that guy liked to have killed us. He'd liked to have killed us. He had us working from 8 o'clock in the morning until 5 o'clock in the evening, plus 8 o'clock the next morning, all night. That's what he did. That's what he did.
